verified_facts.text: The Rittenhouse is at 210 West Rittenhouse Square in Philadelphia.
The hotel has an atrium pool and a spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: our relaxing atrium pool and rejuvenating treatments from the spa

verified_facts.text: Lacroix overlooks Rittenhouse Square and has been a fixture on the square for over two decades.
verified_facts.excerpt: A beloved fixture on Rittenhouse Square for over two decades, Lacroix has evolved into a modern expression of refined dining

verified_facts.text: Lacroix blends French bistro influence with global flavors and has an expertly curated wine cellar.
verified_facts.excerpt: where French bistro influence meets global flavors, and the cocktail program is as considered as the cuisine. Expect seasonally driven menus crafted with the finest local ingredients, an expertly curated wine cellar

verified_facts.text: The Library Bar, just off the lobby, is a book-lined bar with a curated collection of fine and rare books about Philadelphia.
verified_facts.excerpt: explore a curated collection of fine and rare books—ranging from Philadelphia’s storied past to its vibrant creative present

verified_facts.text: The Library Bar is a hideaway just off the lobby serving classic cocktails, rare spirits and small plates.
verified_facts.excerpt: A spirited hideaway just off the lobby, The Library Bar is where classic cocktails, rare spirits, and thoughtful small plates come together in an intimate, book-lined setting.

verified_facts.text: Each room overlooks Rittenhouse Square or the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each of our Rittenhouse hotel rooms quietly overlooks Rittenhouse Square or the city.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with Acqua Di Parma bath amenities.
verified_facts.excerpt: Luxurious marble bathroom featuring Acqua Di Parma bath amenities

verified_facts.text: Rooms get twice daily housekeeping including evening turndown and overnight shoe shining.
verified_facts.excerpt: Twice daily housekeeping including evening turndown service

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms measure between 450 and 600 square feet.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our guest rooms are generously proportioned, measuring between 450 and 600 square feet

verified_facts.text: Specialty Suites have one or two bedrooms, entertainment and dining areas, and a kitchenette.
verified_facts.excerpt: Featuring 1 or 2 bedrooms, inviting entertainment and dining areas, and a kitchenette, Specialty Suites have all the essentials

verified_facts.text: In-room dining serves dishes from Lacroix.
verified_facts.excerpt: Savor curated dishes from Lacroix, thoughtfully prepared and delivered to the comfort and privacy of your room.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has over 12,000 square feet of event space for meetings, weddings and social gatherings.
verified_facts.excerpt: With over 12,000 square feet of versatile event space, The Rittenhouse provides an exceptional setting for meetings, weddings, and social gatherings of every scale.

verified_facts.text: The building's cantilevered facade was designed to give as many rooms as possible park views, creating pointed corner nooks.
verified_facts.excerpt: the building’s cantilevered facade was designed to create generous park views in as many rooms as possible, creating pointed corner nooks

verified_facts.text: The Rittenhouse Spa and Club has an indoor pool, outdoor sun deck, fitness center, full-service spa and salon.
verified_facts.excerpt: The on-site spa, The Rittenhouse Spa and Club - Hair by Paul Labrecque, is a glorious urban escape complete with an indoor pool, outdoor sun deck, fitness center, full-service spa and salon, plus men’s grooming station.

verified_facts.text: Not all rooms have king-size beds.
verified_facts.excerpt: Not all rooms have king-size beds, so be sure to read the fine print before booking

verified_facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler notes that Parc is just across the square.
verified_facts.excerpt: (Stephen Starr's Parc is just across the square after all.)
